name: THE CANTEEN AT THE CUSTER BEACON

violations.description: Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. - Floors have deep cuts and deep cracks in floor.

Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. - Back reach-in cooler found 43-45F. All items moved to another cooler.
